create.name: Julie Reisler
create.bio:
Julie Reisler is an intuitive coach, author and podcaster who teaches people to recognise and trust their own inner guidance. After years in corporate recruiting she retrained as a coach, completing graduate training and board certification as a wellness coach, and she now teaches on Georgetown University's coaching programme. Around fifteen years ago a spiritual awakening opened her to intuitive and channelled work, and she has since built a method she calls Intuition Language, which helps people notice whether their intuition speaks to them through body sensation, imagery, inner knowing or an inner voice.

She trains other coaches through her Intuitive Life Designer Coach Academy, runs a monthly live membership called Alchemy for practising intuition together, offers a self-paced Intuition School and works privately with clients in intensives and longer coaching programmes. She hosts The You-est You podcast, where she talks with teachers, mediums and authors about spiritual life, and posts conversations, short guided meditations and weekly card readings on YouTube. She is the author of the Get a PhD in YOU books and a two-time TEDx speaker.

courses.title: Intuition School
courses.description: A self-paced course in nine modules on her intuition framework, with worksheets, videos, meditations and lifetime access to the recordings.

courses.title: Intuitive Life Designer Coach Certification
courses.description: Her coach training programme, which combines evidence-based coaching skills with full training in Intuition Language and group coaching.

courses.title: Soul Alignment Intensive and 1:1 Coaching
courses.description: A ninety-minute intuitive session on your next step, with longer private coaching programmes for those who want to go further.

free_resources.title: Free Intuition Language Test
free_resources.description: A short quiz that suggests whether you mainly feel, know, see or hear your intuition, with pointers for working with it.

free_resources.title: The You-est You Podcast
free_resources.description: Her long-running podcast of conversations with spiritual teachers, mediums and authors about intuition, purpose and inner life.
